user_request: Update the one doc subsection that still describes the old sidecar-side SDK lookup, after the security fix moved resolution into the host.
instructions:
NEVER run git stash, git checkout, git reset, git restore, git clean, git merge, git rebase, git push, git commit, git mv or any command that changes the index, the stash stack, or other worktrees' state. Do NOT touch crates/. Do NOT write to /tmp. No `timeout` binary on this host: use the perl alarm form. DO NOT EXPLORE: read ONLY docs/architecture/web-cockpit.md lines 240-280. Edit in your first action, then run the verify commands. Do not commit.

FACTS (verified in code): the Claude sidecar no longer resolves the SDK itself. The Rust host (claude_sdk_spawn.rs) runs `npm root -g` FROM THE USER'S HOME DIRECTORY (never the task worktree or the process cwd, so a repository `.npmrc` or `node_modules` can never redirect module resolution), picks the first existing file of `<root>/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.mjs` then `<root>/@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.mjs` (the nested copy that exists on machines that still have the old bridge installed), and passes that ABSOLUTE path to the sidecar as `--sdk-module`. The sidecar loads only that explicit module: it has no bare package import, runs no npm, reads no environment variable for a module path, and with no `--sdk-module` it refuses to initialise (`no --sdk-module given; the host resolves the Claude Agent SDK and passes its absolute path`). An explicit `--sdk-module` that cannot load fails init; nothing else is tried. If no SDK file is found under the global root the spawn fails with `no loadable claude-agent-sdk module under <root> - npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`; if `npm root -g` itself fails the error says so and carries the same install hint.
